name.en-US: The Blessed Sacrament, or the Works and Ways of God
name.pt-BR: O Santíssimo Sacramento, ou as Obras e os Caminhos de Deus

description.en-US: Faber's treatise of 1855 on the Eucharist as the summit of God's works: a prologue on the triumph of the Blessed Sacrament, four books (the Blessed Sacrament the greatest work of God, the devotion of Catholics, a picture of God, a picture of Jesus) and an epilogue on reparation.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Faber (1855) sobre a Eucaristia como o cume das obras de Deus: um prólogo sobre o triunfo do Santíssimo Sacramento, quatro livros (o Santíssimo Sacramento, a maior obra de Deus; a devoção dos católicos; um retrato de Deus; um retrato de Jesus) e um epílogo sobre a reparação.

en-US.editor: Fr. Frederick William Faber (American edition, Baltimore: Murphy, 1855)

sources.edition: The Blessed Sacrament, or the Works and Ways of God (American edition, 1855), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The preface, the prologue and the epilogue are kept; the publisher's note, the analytic table of contents and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fr. Frederick William Faber died in 1863 and the edition is of 1855, so the text is public domain.
